gringo.query: Gringo Bill’s Boutique Hotel Calle Colla Raymi 104, Aguas Calientes

conde.name: Conde de Lemos
conde.desc: A daytime room for a shower and rest between the overnight bus and the lake excursion.
conde.query: Conde de Lemos Jirón Puno 681, Puno

wyndham.name: Wyndham Costa del Sol Arequipa

wyndham.query: Wyndham Costa del Sol Arequipa Plaza Bolívar s/n, Selva Alegre, Arequipa

senoma.name: Senoma Hotel – Adults Only

senoma.query: Senoma Hotel – Adults Only Av. Ángela Perotti s/n, Huacachina

casa.name: Casa Paracas
casa.desc: Our overnight base in Paracas. The following day’s group activities met at Los Frayles.
casa.query: Casa Paracas Alameda Alan García Mz. B Lote 16, El Chaco, Paracas

indigo.name: Hotel Indigo Lima Miraflores

lim.name: Arrival in Lima
lim.desc: The journey began in Lima, with a same-morning connection to Cusco.

cuz.name: Flight to Cusco
cuz.desc: An early flight carried us from the coast into the Andes.

plaza_cusco.name: Plaza de Armas
plaza_cusco.desc: Cusco’s central square: arcades, church façades and our first walk through the city.

sanblas.name: San Blas & its viewpoint
sanblas.desc: A walk through hillside lanes, ending above the red-tiled roofs of Cusco.

pachapapa.name: Pachapapa
pachapapa.desc: Our first-day meal in San Blas, in a restaurant devoted to Cusco’s regional cooking.

sacsay.name: Sacsayhuamán
sacsay.desc: Monumental stonework above Cusco, with great walls fitted together from enormous blocks.

qenqo.name: Q’enqo
qenqo.desc: A sacred rock complex with carved passages and chambers, part of our four-site Cusco circuit.

puka.name: Puka Pukara
puka.desc: Stone terraces and enclosures overlooking the approaches to Cusco.

tambo.name: Tambomachay
tambo.desc: Stone channels and flowing water made this a memorable stop for our interest in Andean sacred places.

pisac.name: Pisac
pisac.desc: A Sacred Valley stop among the mountains and the legacy of Inca terraces.

chinchero.name: Chinchero
chinchero.desc: A highland village known for its Inca heritage and living textile traditions.

moray.name: Moray
moray.desc: Concentric terraces form one of the most distinctive landscapes of the Sacred Valley.

maras.name: Maras salt ponds
maras.desc: Thousands of salt pools cascade down a mountainside near Maras.

ollanta.name: Ollantaytambo
ollanta.desc: Steep terraces and monumental Inca stonework above a town with enduring historic streets.

poroy.name: Poroy → Aguas Calientes
poroy.desc: The outbound train began at Poroy. Our itinerary recorded a journey of 3 hours 46 minutes.

aguas.name: Machu Picchu Pueblo
aguas.desc: A stroll around Aguas Calientes, including its main square and the Pachacútec statue.

chef.name: Chef House
chef.desc: A meal in Aguas Calientes before the next morning’s visit to Machu Picchu.

shuttle.name: Shuttle to Machu Picchu
shuttle.desc: An early bus ride from Aguas Calientes for the first entry of the day.
shuttle.query: Machu Picchu bus station Avenida Hermanos Ayar

machu.name: Machu Picchu · circuit 2B
machu.desc: Our first circuit through the Inca citadel, framed by forested mountains and morning clouds.

huchuy.name: Huchuy Picchu · circuit 3D
huchuy.desc: Our second circuit included the climb to Huchuy Picchu. The summit sign in our photo reads 2,542 m.

trainback.name: Aguas Calientes → Poroy
trainback.desc: The return train brought us back to Poroy, followed by the transfer to Palacio del Inka.

tipon.name: Tipón
tipon.desc: Terraces, fountains and carefully laid channels reveal the skill of Inca water engineering.

piki.name: Pikillacta
piki.desc: A pre-Inca Wari settlement, adding an earlier chapter to the history we explored around Cusco.

andahua.name: Andahuaylillas
andahua.desc: The richly decorated Church of San Pedro Apóstol brought art and spirituality together in the South Valley.

sanpedro.name: San Pedro market & Cusco streets
sanpedro.desc: After resting at the hotel until midday, we walked to the market, bought a cap, ate chairo and saw a procession.

buspuno.name: Overnight bus to Puno
buspuno.desc: Our night on the road began at Peru Hop’s private terminal on Alameda Pachacuteq.
buspuno.query: Peru Hop terminal Alameda Pachacuteq 499 Cusco

uros.name: Uros floating islands
uros.desc: Our Lake Titicaca day began with the islands built from totora reeds.

amantani.name: Amantaní
amantani.desc: A visit to the island community on Lake Titicaca.

llachon.name: Llachón
llachon.desc: The lakeside community on the Capachica peninsula completed our Titicaca excursion.

busaqp.name: Overnight bus to Arequipa
busaqp.desc: Another night crossing the southern Andes, with a bus change along the way.

catalina.name: Monasterio de Santa Catalina
catalina.desc: A visit through the monastery’s colorful courtyards and quiet lanes.

yanahuara.name: Mirador de Yanahuara
yanahuara.desc: White-stone arches, city views and the mountains beyond Arequipa.

alpaca.name: Mundo Alpaca
alpaca.desc: A stop devoted to alpacas and the textile traditions of the Andes.

ascai.name: Ascaí 360
ascai.desc: Our rooftop dining stop in the center of Arequipa, after the afternoon’s walk.

sillar.name: Ruta del Sillar
sillar.desc: The quarries and carving tradition behind Arequipa’s characteristic white stone.
sillar.query: Canteras de Anashuayco Ruta del Sillar Arequipa

culebrillas.name: Cañón de Culebrillas
culebrillas.desc: A walk through the narrow volcanic-rock canyon on our Sillar outing.

coastbus.name: Arequipa → Huacachina
coastbus.desc: A full day on the road through Ocoña, Chala and Nazca, with the desert and Pacific coast along the way.

horno.name: Horno 48
horno.desc: The group stopped for stuffed bread and coffee on the westward journey from Arequipa.

oasis.name: Huacachina oasis
oasis.desc: Arrival among the dunes for our overnight stay in Huacachina.

pisco.name: Culturpisco
pisco.desc: We learned about pisco production and joined a tasting at this Ica stop.

tejas.name: La Casa de las Tejas Rosalía
tejas.desc: After the tasting, we took a class to make Ica’s traditional tejas.
tejas.query: La Casa de las Tejas Rosalia Ica

dunes.name: Buggies & sandboarding
dunes.desc: An afternoon out on Huacachina’s dunes: the buggy ride and sandboarding were the day’s adventure.

busparacas.name: Huacachina → Paracas
busparacas.desc: After the dunes, we continued to the coast for the night at Casa Paracas.

ballestas.name: Ballestas Islands
ballestas.desc: A morning boat excursion from Paracas to the offshore islands.

candelabro.name: The Candelabro
candelabro.desc: We saw the great hillside geoglyph from the boat, on the Paracas peninsula.

vista.name: Vista Paracas
vista.desc: Lunch in Paracas after the boat excursion, before our afternoon on the peninsula.

reserva.name: Paracas National Reserve
reserva.desc: The desert meets the sea. Our visit included Playa Roja and the beach we remembered as Playa Negra.

roja.name: Playa Roja
roja.desc: Red-toned sand against the Pacific: one of the distinctive landscapes of our reserve visit.

negra.name: Playa Negra
negra.desc: The second beach recorded in our trip memories. Its exact map location remains unconfirmed.

hacienda.name: Hacienda San José
hacienda.desc: A stop in Chincha on the way to Lima, at the historic estate in El Carmen.

buslima.name: Paracas → Lima
buslima.desc: The final long road transfer, with the stop at Hacienda San José before reaching Miraflores.

plazalima.name: Plaza Mayor
plazalima.desc: Lima’s historic heart, surrounded by monumental colonial architecture.

domingo.name: Convento de Santo Domingo
domingo.desc: We visited the interior of the Dominican convent, a landmark of Lima’s religious history.

francisco.name: San Francisco & the catacombs
francisco.desc: Our visit included the convent’s underground catacombs.

punto.name: Punto Azul
punto.desc: A seafood meal in Miraflores during our Lima chapter.

larcomar.name: Larcomar
larcomar.desc: An evening look across the Pacific and the lights of the Costa Verde.

malecon.name: Miraflores → Barranco
malecon.desc: We walked the coast from Miraflores to Barranco, then made our way down to the beach.

puente.name: Puente de los Suspiros
puente.desc: A walk across the landmark bridge in Barranco’s historic neighborhood.

beach.name: Down to the beach
beach.desc: The walk continued from the cliffs to the Pacific shore. The exact beach was not recorded.

inca.name: Mercado Inca
inca.desc: A last browse through the handicraft market in Miraflores.

kennedy.name: Parque Kennedy
kennedy.desc: A stroll through the lively park at the heart of Miraflores.

picarones.name: Picarones
picarones.desc: We tried the famous Peruvian sweet fritters during our last day in Lima.

pardos.name: Pardos Chicken
pardos.desc: A final Lima meal at Pardos, known for Peruvian pollo a la brasa.

airport.name: The journey home
airport.desc: We left Hotel Indigo on the evening of October 17 for our early-morning flight.

days.title: First steps in Cusco
days.subtitle: From an overnight arrival to the rooftops of San Blas.

days.title: Stone, sky & sacred water
days.subtitle: Four archaeological sites above Cusco.
days.reflection: A personal lens: the relationship between stone, water and landscape was a thread we followed throughout the trip.
days.logistics: The four-site outing was planned for 07:00–14:00. These are the recorded plan times, not measured arrival and departure times.

days.title: Across the Sacred Valley
days.subtitle: Pisac, Chinchero, Moray, Maras and Ollantaytambo.
days.logistics: All five stops were completed. Their exact order was not recorded; the list is a reading sequence, not a timed route.

days.title: The train into the mountains
days.subtitle: Poroy to Aguas Calientes, with an overnight stay.

days.title: Machu Picchu, twice over
days.subtitle: Two circuits, a summit and a day among the clouds.
days.reflection: A personal lens: sacred landscape and a sense of perspective. Spiritual interpretations are personal reflections, not archaeological facts.

days.title: The South Valley
days.subtitle: Inca waterworks, Wari history and Andean Baroque.
days.reflection: A day that connected water engineering, pre-Inca history and the sacred art of a living church.

days.title: One last Cusco wander
days.subtitle: A slow morning, the market and a night on the road.
days.logistics: Hotel rest until around noon. The bus was scheduled to reach Puno at 05:00 on October 10.

days.title: A day on Lake Titicaca
days.subtitle: Uros → Amantaní → Llachón.
days.reflection: Living traditions and the lake landscape were the focus of this chapter.
days.logistics: Day-use room at Conde de Lemos before the lake outing. Tour pickup was scheduled there at 07:00, with return at 17:00. A bus change was announced about 90 minutes into the onward trip.

days.title: The White City
days.subtitle: Monastery courtyards, a viewpoint and a rooftop table.
days.logistics: We arrived in Arequipa in the morning. The afternoon included Yanahuara and a walk back via Mundo Alpaca toward Ascaí 360.

days.title: Carved from volcanic stone
days.subtitle: The Sillar route and the narrow walls of Culebrillas.
days.logistics: The operator arranged hotel pickup between 09:00 and 09:20. The outing was completed.

days.title: From the Andes to the dunes
days.subtitle: A road day along southern Peru’s desert coast.
days.logistics: Route via Ocoña, Chala and Nazca. A Chala lunch stop was announced for the group; our individual participation was not recorded. Huacachina arrival was scheduled for 19:15.

days.title: Pisco, tejas & desert skies
days.subtitle: A hands-on Ica morning, then adventure in the dunes.
days.logistics: Peru Hop announced an 11:00 Culturpisco departure. The dune meeting at Senoma was updated to 15:45; the activity start was 16:30. The onward bus meeting was 18:45 at Wild Rover, with arrival in Paracas scheduled for 20:30.

days.title: Where the desert meets the sea
days.subtitle: Boat, geoglyph, beaches and a historic stop on the way north.
days.logistics: Los Frayles was the announced meeting point: the boat meeting changed from 09:45 to 10:15; lunch gathering 12:20; reserve meeting 14:15 for a 14:30 departure; Lima bus meeting 16:15. These were group notices, not verified actual times. Hotel arrival was scheduled for 22:30.

days.title: Lima, old and new
days.subtitle: Convents in the historic center, seafood and the Pacific.
days.reflection: Sacred art, cloisters and the catacombs offered another perspective on Peru’s layers of religious history.

days.title: A long walk by the Pacific
days.subtitle: Miraflores, Barranco and a final taste of Lima.
days.logistics: The final night’s hotel reservation extended to October 18, but we left for the airport on October 17.

days.title: Home, with a little Peru
days.subtitle: The end of a wonderful journey.
days.reflection: Sixteen calendar days of mountains, living traditions, food and the Pacific. A journey to keep revisiting.
